A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 17-page SpatialStack paper, including supplementary Sections A–F. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish that pages 2–17 are identical; first-page differences are confined to author/affiliation information and the arXiv stamp. No material gaps limit comparison.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original SpatialStack benchmark evaluations, layer-selection and fusion-order ablations, and supplementary CV-Bench results and feature visualizations.

after.justification: v3.pdf retains the original benchmark evaluations and ablations in Tables 1–7, supplementary results in Table C, and feature analyses in Figure C.

M1.justification: Sections 4 and Appendix A retain the same architecture, geometry-token processing, masked additive fusion, training objective, and inference procedure. VGGT layers 11/17/23 still feed LLM layers 0/1/2.

E1.justification: The training mixture and evaluated tasks are identical. Both versions retain SPAR, LLaVA-Hound, VLM-3R ScanNet, and VSI-590K training sources and the same spatial and general-capability benchmarks, including the supplementary CV-Bench evaluation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment. This includes the geometry-vision fusion baselines in Table 2, benchmark comparators in Tables 3–5, and SpatialRGPT and Spatialbot in supplementary Table C.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices B–D retain identical sampling, preprocessing, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, and decoding settings. No evaluation protocol is added or revised.

E4.justification: The geometry-depth study, fusion comparisons, layer-selection and fusion-order ablations, and geometry-versus-vision feature analyses are identical, including Figure 4, Tables 1–2 and 6–7, and supplementary Figure C.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or formal significance tests for the experimental results.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, rankings, plotted trends, and qualitative findings are identical. For example, SpatialStack-5B retains 67.5 on VSI-Bench in Table 3 and 85.5 on CV-Bench in Table 4; supplementary Table C also remains unchanged.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(17), tensor definitions, token-alignment formulations, and masked-fusion mathematics are unchanged. No assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about hierarchical geometry-language fusion, the systematic layer analysis, benchmark performance, and generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations of shallow versus deep features, interference from naive fusion, cross-task generalization, and retained general capabilities are unchanged. No substantive qualification or limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: Appendices A–D retain identical implementation details, dataset composition, hyperparameters, hardware, preprocessing, and evaluation instructions. The project link and resource-access statements are unchanged.

R1.justification: The references and related-work discussion are identical, including positioning relative to DeepStack, Spatial-MLLM, VG-LLM, and VLM-3R. No cited work or novelty relationship changes.

P1.justification: The first-author name changes from Jiang Zhang to Jian Zhang, and that author's affiliation changes from TAMU to XMU. Zhiwen Fan remains affiliated with TAMU under the new index 5, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions, axes, legends, and their placement are unchanged. The first-page author and stamp text updates do not reorganize the layout; pages 2–17 render identically.

improvement.justification: v3.pdf changes only author/affiliation information and the version/date stamp. The scientific content, supporting evidence, reproducibility details, and presentation of the main text and appendices remain identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
